title: Bound affine packing for the stage-17 parity shell
body:
**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7334/#7113 at Type B clocks 4646 and 4660, change the erased action for the two complementary stage-17 returns. Let D be the original body and X=D² its translation. The ordinary parity shell E=((1+i)I+(1−i)X)/2 leaves a residual only at Walsh weights 2 or 3 mod 4. At width one the two lanes have 240 residual directions out of 512 tested. At all widths the total residual occupies 1−2^(−4f) of one old lane by count.

Both exact replays show that these addresses nevertheless span the full two-lane affine chart. One affine selection therefore needs two old lane volumes. A rank-16 field can afford less than 1.003 under the quoted volume-linear tariff, with all ancillary work free. At the incumbent crossing the directed gross is about −126.391663475 raw across eight ports. This excludes the specified parity shell with one affine Walsh-address chart. Non-affine selection, several charts and other bypasses remain open. Price one exact changed selector before building it.

Run python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage17-parity-shell-affine-bound/replay.py from a clean POSIX checkout. It pins the original projector and caller and compares two exact support checks, including forward and adjoint and corruption controls. Registered, read-only Git-free export and all 27 onboarding checks passed locally. The branch carries the two #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7406 supplies the complementary projector reduction, #7397 the tariff, and #7334/#7113 and #7362/#7298 the exact comparator, caller and price. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
